## Change

`changes/NNNN-slug/` — link the intent, spec and plan.

## Evidence

Commands run and their output (`python scripts/gate.py check`, `python scripts/gate.py test`, ...).

## Anything outside the plan

New dependencies, network calls, secrets, permissions, scope changes, open questions.
